title: N
description: Metanet's minimalist ninja platformer: one fragile stick figure, 100 brutal rooms, and pure momentum.
controls: Arrow keys move, Space jumps. Press P to pause.

title: QWOP
description: Bennett Foddy's four-key ragdoll sprint. Control each leg separately and try to travel 100 metres upright.
controls: Q/W control the thighs, O/P control the calves. Tap rhythmically; there is no sprint button.

title: The World's Hardest Game
description: Guide a red square through 30 rooms of spikes, bullets and moving walls. One touch sends you back to the start.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD move. Reach the green zone.

title: Bloxorz
description: Roll a 1x1x2 block across floating tiles and drop it into the hole. Simple rules, fiendish 33-level campaign.
controls: Arrow keys roll the block. Follow the on-screen hints for split tiles.

title: Achievement Unlocked
description: jmtb02's genre parody where the real goal is to collect every absurd achievement, including the ones that make no sense.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD move, Space jumps. Do odd things to unlock achievements.

title: Motherload
description: XGen Studios' cult mining game. Drill deeper, manage fuel and cargo, and chase the motherlode before the tank runs dry.
controls: Arrow keys move and drill. Follow the in-game tutorial for fuel, cargo and upgrades.

title: Interactive Buddy
description: A stress-ball sandbox with a ragdoll buddy, unlockable toys and a lot of questionable physics.
controls: Mouse to grab, throw and poke. Use the toolbar to spawn toys.

title: Age of War
description: Louissi's lane strategy classic: evolve your base from cavemen to future tech and hold the line against the other age.
controls: Mouse to build units and upgrade your base. Click special abilities when charged.

title: Bloons TD 2
description: Ninja Kiwi's monkey-and-dart tower defense. Ten tracks, six towers and a lot of popping.
controls: Mouse to place towers and start waves. Click a tower to upgrade or sell.

title: Learn to Fly
description: Launch a penguin, upgrade the sled, and chain glide distance into a surprisingly deep progression loop.
controls: Mouse to launch and buy upgrades. Click at the right moment to glide.

title: Doodle Jump
description: Lima Sky's one-more-jump vertical platformer. Bounce upward, steer past hazards and never look down.
controls: Left/right arrows or A/D steer. Land on platforms and avoid the void.

title: The Fancy Pants Adventure
description: Brad Borne's hand-drawn platformer with momentum-heavy running, wall jumps and secret rooms.
controls: Arrows or WASD move, Space jumps, Down slides. Momentum is everything.

title: Riddle School
description: JonBro's point-and-click escape comedy. Click everything, combine the weird, and get out of class.
controls: Mouse to click and interact. Use inventory items on the world.

title: Storm the House
description: Hold a house against waves of stickmen. Buy weapons, repair the walls, and survive the siege.
controls: Mouse to aim and shoot. Buy weapons and repairs between waves.

title: Portal: The Flash Version
description: We Create Stuff's 2D Portal fan game: 40 test chambers, portals, cubes, buttons and turrets.
controls: Arrows or WASD move, mouse aims, click places portals, Space jumps.

title: Super Meat Boy
description: The original Flash prototype of Team Meat's masocore platformer: short, sharp, bloody and instantly retryable.
controls: Arrows or WASD move, Space jumps, Shift runs. Reach the exit.

title: Pandemic 2
description: Dark Realm's outbreak sim. Design a pathogen, evolve symptoms and try to end humanity before a cure is found.
controls: Mouse to choose traits and evolve. Manage visibility and cure progress.

title: Papa's Pizzeria
description: Flipline's order-stacking restaurant sim. Take orders, build pizzas, bake them and keep the customers happy.
controls: Mouse to take orders, add toppings and bake. Follow the customer tickets.

title: Duck Life
description: Train a duck in running, swimming, flying and climbing, then race it to the championship.
controls: Mouse to train and race. Follow the prompts for each event.

title: Stick RPG
description: XGen's stick-figure life sim. Get a job, go to school, buy stuff, and chase a better ending.
controls: Mouse to move and interact. Keyboard for some minigames.

title: Rubik's Cube
description: A 3D Rubik's Cube simulator for mouse and keyboard. Scramble, solve, repeat.
controls: Mouse drag to rotate faces. Use the on-screen controls to scramble and reset.

title: Checkers
description: The classic board game, playable in the browser with a friend or the computer.
controls: Mouse to select and move pieces.

title: Minesweeper
description: The Windows classic. Clear the board without detonating a mine.
controls: Mouse to reveal tiles. Right-click to flag.

title: Pac-Man
description: The arcade icon in a compact Flash version. Eat the dots, dodge the ghosts, grab the fruit.
controls: Arrow keys to move. Eat all dots and avoid ghosts.

title: Tetris
description: The falling-block classic. Clear lines, chase the high score, and resist the urge to stack one more piece.
controls: Arrow keys move and rotate. Space drops.

title: Snake
description: The Nokia-era time killer. Eat, grow, and don't bite yourself.
controls: Arrow keys to steer. Eat food, avoid walls and yourself.
